male.method: Umbilicus: textured orthographic inspection and front-centerline mesh dimple. Xiphoid/pubic reference levels are region estimates on the stylized clothed mesh; abdominal B-cun is interpolated separately above and below the umbilicus, not from total height.

female.method: Umbilicus: textured orthographic inspection and front-centerline mesh dimple. Xiphoid/pubic reference levels are region estimates under clothing, not palpable bony landmarks; abdominal B-cun is interpolated separately above and below the umbilicus.
